# stalwart_dsn_report_settings (Resource)

Configures Delivery Status Notification (DSN) report generation. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dkim_sign_domain` (Attributes) Which domain's DKIM signatures to use when signing the Delivery Status Notifications (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dkim_sign_domain))
- `from_address` (Attributes) Email address that will be used in the From header of Delivery Status Notifications (DSN) reports (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--from_address))
- `from_name` (Attributes) Name that will be used in the From header of Delivery Status Notifications (DSN) reports (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--from_name))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
